presets.name: Optical amp throb
presets.desc: Medium-speed photocell tremolo: rounded, lopsided dips like a 60s combo amp's built-in effect
presets.notes: Lamp + LDR shapes the sine into long highs and short dips; depth 0.6 throbs without chopping; +1.5 dB makes up the average drop

presets.name: Jungle-beat pulse
presets.desc: Deep, fast, choppy tremolo that cuts chords in and out over a clave strum

refs.why: the DeArmond trem's uneven warble trailing his clave rhythm

presets.notes: Neon strike/extinguish gives the choppy, near-gated dips at full depth; 6.5 Hz sits around the beat's subdivisions without syncing

presets.name: Swampy bias breathe
presets.desc: Slow-ish valve-bias tremolo that adds grit at the trough and softens when you dig in

refs.why: the swampy amp vibrato on Fogerty's E7 riff, from his Kustom amp

presets.notes: Bias model: crossover grit near the trough, sag ducks the depth on hard strums; Fogerty calls it vibrato, the Kustom blended both

presets.name: Surf instrumental shimmer
presets.desc: Fast, deep optical tremolo for twangy single-note melodies under spring reverb

refs.why: menacing amp tremolo on sustained twangy chords

presets.notes: The crate's surf starting point (Optical 6 Hz, 0.8); pair with a drippy spring reverb after it

presets.name: Desert western throb
presets.desc: Slower, deep optical pulse for baritone-style twang and reverb-drenched western melodies

refs.why: the twangy, reverb-soaked western guitar this patch evokes

presets.notes: A touch of duck lets the attack of each note ring through before the pulse takes over

presets.name: Synced sixteenth thrum
presets.desc: Deep, choppy amp tremolo locked to sixteenths, slightly offset L/R like several amps at once

refs.why: Marr's rhythm re-amped through several Twins with tremolo on

presets.notes: Neon = blackface choppy; synced so it never drifts (the original had to be edited for that); 60° stereo offset mimics two amp pairs

presets.name: Brownface harmonic pulse
presets.desc: Highs and lows swell in opposition: a phaser-like, level-steady harmonic tremolo
presets.notes: The crate's brownface start: antiphase bands keep the level steady, so little makeup is needed

presets.name: Slow harmonic shimmer
presets.desc: Slow, wide harmonic tremolo that makes sustained chords swirl rather than pulse
presets.notes: Higher crossover moves the swirl into the mids; 90° stereo phase spreads it without becoming an auto-pan

presets.name: Helicopter chop
presets.desc: Full-depth square-wave tremolo at 10 Hz: the signal stutters on and off like rotor blades
presets.notes: golem's old Helicopter; the 2 ms square edges never click; works on clean or high-gain sustained notes

presets.name: Tempo-locked eighth chop
presets.desc: Square tremolo synced to eighth notes, short-on duty: a rhythmic chop for pads and chords
presets.notes: Phase follows the host position, so the chops land on the grid; Clean adds no distortion on synths

presets.name: Pulsing sustain lead
presets.desc: Bias tremolo that backs off while you pick and pulses in on the sustain of each note
presets.notes: Dynamics 0.6 is the crate's 'depth that follows the playing': attacks stay solid, tails throb like a cooking tube amp

presets.name: Slow heavy throb
presets.desc: Slow, deep optical swell on distorted chords: a wall of fuzz that breathes in and out
presets.notes: Place after the drive: a compressed high-gain signal has no dynamics left, so the tremolo must do the pulsing

presets.name: Gentle chord motion
presets.desc: Shallow, slow clean tremolo that adds movement to strummed or arpeggiated chords

presets.name: Electric-piano stereo pan
presets.desc: Sine auto-pan between L and R: the stereo vibrato of a suitcase electric piano
presets.notes: 180° = auto-pan: the summed level stays constant, so no makeup; Clean keeps the tines undistorted

presets.name: Clean bass pulse
presets.desc: Tempo-synced clean tremolo on bass: eighth-note pumping without adding grit
presets.notes: Clean model adds no distortion to the fundamental; synced so the pump stays with the drums

presets.name: Warbling psych vocal
presets.desc: Fast, deep tremolo on a voice: the sung line wobbles as if sung through a guitar amp

refs.why: the vocal sung through an amp's tremolo on the outro

presets.notes: Bias with low drive gives the amp's soft compression without audible distortion on the voice
